status: sealed static arithmetic contract and independently validated bounded reconstruction
scope: Cubase15.0.30.287 arm64 mode0 Float32 mono/stereo finite equal/downsample sample-producing branches. This is a conditional reconstruction of inner arithmetic; it is not the default selected backend or live-host equivalence.

dispatch.early_return: signed input count<=0 returns0 before state mutation or flush handling
dispatch.step: child+8 = one RN64 division of widened source/output Float32 rates
dispatch.equal_rate: Step1 uses small-ratio arithmetic. It is not a copy and must not be substituted for the application existing equal-rate source path.

arithmetic.rounding: RN64 and RN32 mean IEEE nearest/even with denormal flushing disabled; each indicated arithmetic operation rounds separately. FMA is a single rounding of product+addend. Input samples are Float32.
small_ratio: delta=RN64(step+(-1)). At entry phase<1 and pending: interpolate RN32(history) with input[0], then narrow result toFloat32 and widen back toDouble history; phase=RN64(phase+delta).
If that phase>=1: phase=RN64(phase+(-1)); emit the narrowed history; consume one input frame. Otherwise carry a local queued=true.

For each available adjacent input pair while phase<1: compute interpolation; if queued, emit old history then retain the new mixed value as unrounded binary64; otherwise emit RN32(mixed). Advance one input and phase=RN64(delta+phase).
When phase>=1, subtract1, skip one input, and emit queued history once if present; clear local queued. Continue while native remaining-pair counter is positive.

At terminal local queued=true, native compares unsigned outputcursor<=inputcursor. Entire disjoint output BELOW input admits one additional queued output and two external helpers; ABOVE excludes both. This reconstruction records the sample/count semantics but does not execute diagnostic helpers.
Final pending equals !lastSkip. If !lastSkip, history is overwritten with the input at final cursor. Otherwise existing binary64 history is preserved. phase stored exactly.

If initial pending/phase consumes the sole logical input, tail dereferences the next frame outside that count. This is an observed bound, not asserted product bug: allocation/lookahead authority is unbound. Defensive wrapper rejects with LOOKAHEAD before changes.
large_ratio: If phase<0 and pending, interpolate prior history against first new frame and emit one. Mono uses w=RN64(phase+1), product=RN64(w*first), FMSUB equivalent FMA64(-phase,RN32(history),product). Stereo uses oldWeight=RN64(1-RN64(phase+1)),newWeight=RN64(1-oldWeight),then separately rounded product+FMA. Preserve the extra stereo subtraction.

Advance phase=RN64(step+phase). For floor(phase)<inputFrames-1, index=FCVTMS(phase),fraction=RN64(phase-index),emit interpolation of input[index] and input[index+1],advance phase=RN64(step+phase). FCVTMS is floor, not C truncation for negative values.
arithmetic.flush: W4 forwarded but not read in the complete mono/stereo admitted bodies. No input means no state change/output, even flush1. No invented tail or last-frame padding.
arithmetic.partition: No partition invariance is asserted for small ratios. Queue and terminal ordering cause measurable count/sample differences. Application aggregate count and processing use the identical explicit partition rule.

application_policy.chosen_layout: ABOVE; one allocated arena with input first and disjoint output after all logical input bytes
application_policy.partition: up to8192 source frames; if remaining==8193, take8191 then2; total input1 can produce0. Generic count_blocks requires limit>=3 and uses remaining==limit+1?limit-1:min(remaining,limit).
application_policy.unsupported: No unprovided lookahead, full-host allocator or callback invariance, arbitrary channels, nonfinite samples, denormal output, out-of-domain rates, downsample anti-alias-quality claim, default-mode selection, source-clock selection, live timeline/backend equivalence. App source equal-rate remains the existing route.
application_policy.gain: Previously bound offline inner consumer reads converted PCM before separateFloat32 segment gain; this is independent from live-backend integration.

candidate.bounds: 8000<=output<=source<=192000 Float32;channels1/2;finite normal-or-zero Float32 input/output;historyfinitebinary64;16m input/result cap;roundnearest,FTZ/FIZdisabled.
